title: Shared relations, specific choices: conditional sensitivity and competing pathways in language models
abstract: arXiv:2611.01809v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: How does a relational representation shared across queries drive a query-specific choice? Controlled entity-binding experiments with GPT-2 Small, Qwen2.5-1.5B and Llama-3.2-1B reveal a low-dimensional relational background that is predominantly shared across query roles and transfers to new names. Same-domain interactions persist when another attribute domain is queried. After removing this component, restoring independently trained relation directions brings output contrasts closer to their original values than sign-reversed or equal-norm random controls in all three models. Yet a transferable relational representation need not have a transferable functional sign. In Qwen2.5, fixing model weights, the training-mean relation vector and edit dose yields opposite selection effects across binary and lexical-mapping prompts with different answer vocabularies. A factorial contrast of downstream sensitivities across attribute-query combination

translated_title: 共享关系，特定选择：语言模型中的条件敏感性与竞争通路
translated_abstract: 跨查询共享的关系表征如何驱动针对特定查询的选择？通过在GPT-2 Small、Qwen2.5-1.5B和Llama-3.2-1B上进行受控的实体绑定实验，我们揭示了一个低维的关系背景，该背景在不同查询角色之间基本共享，并能迁移到新的名称上。当查询另一个属性域时，同域交互仍然持续存在。在移除该组件后，恢复独立训练得到的关系方向能使输出对比比符号反转或等范数随机对照更接近原始值，这一结果在所有三个模型中均得到验证。然而，可迁移的关系表征不一定具有可迁移的功能符号。在Qwen2.5中，固定模型权重时，训练均值关系向量和编辑剂量在具有不同答案词表的二元提示与词表映射提示之间产生相反的选择效应。
tldr: 该研究揭示语言模型中存在跨查询共享且可迁移到新实体的低维关系表征，但其功能符号并非必然可迁移——相同的关系向量编辑在不同类型提示下会产生相反的选择效应。
en_tdlr: The study reveals that language models share a low-dimensional relational representation that transfers across queries and to new entities, but its functional sign is not necessarily transferable—the same relation vector edit can produce opposite selection effects across different prompt types.
